# Components

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/gen_components.ts from the editor's component tables. Don't edit. -->

Every component the editor's **Add component** list offers, grouped the same way, with each field's default. The same descriptions appear as tooltips in the inspector. Scripts: see [SCRIPT_API.md](SCRIPT_API.md).

## Transform

### Transform

Where the entity is (world units, Y up).

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | x=0 y=0 z=0 |  |

### Rotation

Which way it faces (radians about each axis).

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `euler` | x=0 y=0 z=0 |  |

### Scale

Its size; also the default size of instances spawned from a prefab.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | x=1 y=1 z=1 |  |

## Movement & Physics

### Velocity

Movement in units per second, applied every tick.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | x=0 y=0 z=0 |  |

### Acceleration

Change in velocity per second (e.g. gravity on a projectile).

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | x=0 y=0 z=0 |  |

### Physics Body (`RigidBody`)

Lets physics move it. Dynamic bodies fall and get pushed; kinematic ones only move when told.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mass` | 1 | Mass (kg) |
| `inverseMass` | 1 | Inverse mass (derived) |
| `dynamic` | true | Dynamic (off = kinematic) |

### Collider

Its solid shape for physics, or a trigger volume that reports overlaps to scripts.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | "AABB" | one of AABB, Sphere |
| `halfExtents` | x=0.5 y=0.5 z=0.5 |  |
| `radius` | 0.5 |  |
| `isTrigger` | false | Trigger (overlap only, not solid) |
| `layer` | 0 | Layer (0-31) |
| `mask` | 4294967295 | Collides with (layer bitmask). Which layers this collides with, as a bitmask (4294967295 = all). |
| `bounciness` | 0 | Bounciness (0-1) |

## Gameplay

### Health

Hit points. At 0 the entity is defeated (scripts get on_death).

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `current` | 100 |  |
| `maximum` | 100 |  |

### AI Behavior (`AIState`)

A simple wander/chase/flee brain for walkers and animals.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `state` | "Idle" | one of Idle, Walking, Running, Driving, Fleeing, Chasing, Dead |

### AICombat

A soldier brain: patrol, guard or hunt; sight, hearing, cover and accuracy.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `team` | 1 | Team (Player is 0) |
| `behavior` | "Patrol" | one of Patrol, Guard, Hunt |
| `patrol` | "" | Patrol waypoints (entity names, comma-separated). Entity names to walk between, comma-separated. |
| `sightRange` | 25 | Sight range |
| `fov` | 110 | Field of view (degrees) |
| `hearingRange` | 30 | Hearing range (gunfire) |
| `reactionTime` | 0.45 | Reaction time (s) |
| `accuracy` | 0.6 | Accuracy (0-1) |
| `preferredRange` | 12 | Preferred fighting range |
| `moveSpeed` | 3.6 | Move speed |
| `burst` | 4 | Shots per burst |
| `burstPause` | 0.7 | Pause between bursts (s) |
| `useCover` | true | Takes cover |
| `fleeHealth` | 0 | Flee below health (0-1, 0 = never) |
| `meleeDamage` | 12 | Melee damage (without Weapons) |

### Pedestrian

Makes it a walking person, with a pace and look.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `archetype` | 0 | Archetype. one of Casual, Brisk, Lingering |

### Player

The entity the keyboard and mouse control.

Guns the entity carries.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|

### Melee

Martial-arts fighting: punch and kick combos, specials, dodges, blocks and parries, for the Player or an AI fighter.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `style` | "Martial arts" | Martial arts and Sword are built-in move lists; Custom uses the Moves text below.. one of Martial arts, Sword, Custom |
| `moves` | "# Punches (light): jab, cross, hook, up… | Moves (Custom style; name: key=value ...). One move per line: name: clip=... input=light\|heavy\|kick\|special\|dodge after=a\|b seq=bf dur= hit=a-b cancel= dmg= reach= knock= launch= stun= lunge= cost= ... (see docs/COMBAT.md). |
| `team` | 1 | Team (Player is 0) |
| `ai` | true | AI fighter (not the Player) |
| `aggression` | 0.5 | Aggression (0-1). How often an AI fighter attacks. |
| `skill` | 0.5 | Skill (0-1). How often an AI fighter blocks, parries and dodges, and how long its combos run. |
| `reaction` | 0.25 | Reaction time (seconds) |
| `energy` | 0 | Starting energy (0-100) |
| `guard` | 60 | Guard |

### Site

A place on a planet of the SpaceSystem; its children are built there.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | "Site" |  |
| `body` | "" | Body (SpaceSystem) |
| `latitude` | 0 |  |
| `longitude` | 0 |  |
| `radius` | 400 | Landing radius (m) |

### Routine

A daily schedule: the entity walks to each stop at its hour and does the activity there.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `stops` | "8 0 0; 18 10 0" | Stops (hour x z; ...). Each stop is an hour (0-24), an x and z position, and an optional activity (sit, talk, work, hammer, graze). The entity heads for the latest stop whose hour has passed. |
| `speed` | 1.4 | Walk speed (m/s). Walking speed in metres per second. |

### Wildlife

An animal that grows wary of the player and flees, staying near home.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `wary` | 44 | Wary within (m). Within this distance of a threat the animal stops and watches. |
| `flee` | 16 | Flee within (m). Within this distance it runs (twice as far from a sprinting player). |
| `speed` | 7 | Run speed (m/s) |
| `leash` | 80 | Leash from home (m). It never runs farther than this from where it started. |

## Scripting & Audio

### Script

Lua code that runs while playing (on_start, on_tick, on_ui, ...). See the API reference.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | "-- @prop speed 3"… | Lua source. Lua. Callbacks: on_start, on_tick(dt), on_ui, on_message, on_damaged, on_death, on_kill, on_collision_enter/stay/exit, on_trigger_enter/stay/exit, on_anim_state, on_anim_event. Tables: world, input, ui, sound, camera, anim, physics, weapon, vehicle, particles, game, save, space, host. Help → Script API lists every function. |
| `props.speed` | 3 |  |

### Sound

A sound from the catalog, played in the world.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `clip` | 1 | Clip. one of Ambient: Engine Idle, Ambient: Force Field, Stinger: Melee Hit, Stinger: Metal Hit, Stinger: Explosion, Stinger: Glass Break, Stinger: Bell, Stinger: Door Open, Stinger: Door Close, Stinger: Coin Pickup |
| `volume` | 1 |  |
| `loop` | false |  |
| `autoplay` | true |  |
| `spatial` | false | Positional (3D) |
| `bus` | "SFX" | Mixer bus. one of SFX, Music, Ambient, UI |
| `minDistance` | 2 | Full volume within (3D) |
| `maxDistance` | 60 | Fades out by (3D) |

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `master` | 1 | Master volume (0-2) |
| `sfx` | 1 | SFX volume |
| `music` | 0.7 | Music volume |
| `ambient` | 0.8 | Ambient volume |
| `ui` | 1 | UI volume |

| `occlusion` | true | Muffle sounds behind walls |

| `lookHeight` | 1 | Look height |
| `collision` | true | Avoid obstacles |
| `orbit` | false | Orbit by dragging |

### InputActions

Named actions (jump, fire, ...) and the keys and buttons bound to them.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `bindings` | "move_x: d, -a, right, -left, pad_lx"… | Action bindings (action: input, input) |
